suite: 3D pane follows the selection (sweep, bind, reload, hover)
expect_red: [real] a reload reopens the pane the reader left open, at the width they left it

mutations.contract: A pane left open reopens after a reload.
mutations.note: The stored flag is written correctly and nothing reads it at boot -- the round-trip test of the storage pair passes over exactly this.

mutations.contract: The remembered width is the reader's preference, fitted per page -- not clamped against the boot-time layout.
mutations.note: This is the bug the first run of this suite found: clamped at boot, before the kinematic page has loaded, a 700px preference came back as the 560px floor of a page the reader was not on.
